question: Should ClawHub sponsor the full publisher follow and durable notification product in this PR, or should this contribution be narrowed to public feed routes while the follow/API/data-model work is reviewed separately?
rationale: The branch adds a permanent user-preference model, public API contract, notification delivery semantics, and discovery UX without recorded maintainer confirmation; choosing that permanent product boundary is not safe to infer from implementation alone.

options.title: Narrow the route layer
options.body: Retarget or split the branch so this PR contains only canonical feed routes and redirects, with follow and notification work moved to separately sponsored changes.

options.title: Sponsor the full stack
options.body: Approve the follow and notification contract, then require scalable fanout, compatibility validation, focused documentation, and real-instance proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Close or defer the branch if durable publisher follows and notifications are not currently a ClawHub product priority.

recommendation.title: Narrow the route layer
recommendation.body: Retarget or split the branch so this PR contains only canonical feed routes and redirects, with follow and notification work moved to separately sponsored changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the established publisher identity model and a new permanent user-facing product contract rather than only route implementation details.
